steps.eval: (async () => { const c = await ApiClient.getPluginConfiguration(__vars.jeVersion.Id); const out = {}; Object.keys(c).filter(k => /review|translat|anilist|tmdb.*rating/i.test(k)).sort().forEach(k => { const v = c[k]; out[k] = typeof v === 'boolean' || typeof v === 'number' ? v : (typeof v === 'string' ? (v === '' ? '(empty)' : '(text, ' + v.length + ' characters)') : (Array.isArray(v) ? '(list of ' + v.length + ')' : typeof v)); }); return { count: Object.keys(c).length, settings: out }; })()
